output.content: During the pipeline sync, {data_dave} mentioned how the nightly data flow currently operates. The hand-over from the ingestion layer to the validation stage is triggered by a manual request. When the batch of point of sale scan lines and stock receipts lands in the staging area, no automated event fires. A team member must send a specific command to start the validation checks. This manual step happens every night before the quality control phase begins. The validation logic runs as expected once that initial trigger is received, but the start of the process depends on that human action. The rest of the pipeline proceeds without further manual intervention after that point.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current operational state of the pipeline, specifically noting the manual trigger required for validation, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
